roundup.text:
SN11 is changing the miner-reward path. Activation is the part I still want verified.

TrajectoryRL merged a default-on mode intended to burn the miner share. That is code, not proof it is live, and it is different from an executed transaction burn.

Today’s report also covers Zils’ per-question model-delivery gates, the Pod versions 404-GEN operators need to match, THOR’s finalized owner-key change, and the Vanta and Ormas burns verified on-chain.

Merged, planned and executed are different stages. I keep them separate so you can see what has actually changed.

Read today’s full report:
https://shizzyunchained.com/subnet-news/2026-11-08
